svg.title: Of the 433 units in the National Park System, only 63 are designated national parks, and cancellation stamps are found at nearly all of them.
svg.desc: A grid of 433 small squares, one for each unit of the National Park System. 63 squares are red for the national parks, such as Yellowstone and Yosemite; the rest are light brown for national monuments, historic sites, seashores, battlefields, parkways and preserves. A note reads: cancellation stamps are at nearly all 433.
svg.text: 433 units in the National Park System
